correspondence: lean/docs/115.md (SHA-256 7503f6655041af84) names as its accompanying paper(s) “Exact Uniform Sampling of Contingency Tables with Arbitrary Margins”; “An FPRAS for Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables”, lists the comparator statement lean/ComparatorChallenges/ContingencyTables.lean (SHA-256 809f0a2575fb97e5) for “Exact and bounded-time sampling of contingency tables”, and says: “The formalization gives an exact uniform sampler for nonnegative integer contingency tables with arbitrary prescribed row and column sums having equal totals. Expected bit complexity is polynomial in the dimensions and the binary length of the margins.” “It also gives a sampler with a fixed polynomial time bound on every execution whose total-variation error is at most $2^{-k}$ for requested precision $k\ge1$. The same Comparator file includes the companion approximation scheme for counting tables with individual cell bounds.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
